overview: Tallies the [GMX-V 2.0](http://www.xtm-intl.com/manuals/gmx-v/GMX-V-2.0.html) `LeveragedMatchedWordCount` category — the word count for text units matched against a leveraged translation memory database. It reads the `AltTranslationsAnnotation` left by a leveraging step and counts a target segment or text container only when its top match is of type `EXACT`, `EXACT_LOCAL_CONTEXT`, or `EXACT_STRUCTURAL`, counting the words in the corresponding source. Counts are stored as GMX-V metrics annotations on segments, targets, and aggregate resources for downstream consumption (for example by the Scoping Report Step). This is the word-count variant; a companion step counts characters for the same category.
processingNotes: Only the top-ranked alternate translation of each segment is examined; it qualifies when its match type is `EXACT`, `EXACT_LOCAL_CONTEXT`, or `EXACT_STRUCTURAL`.
Counts are computed over the source content of qualifying units; only translatable text units are counted, and a target must be present.
Requires a prior leveraging step to have populated the alternate-translation annotations with categorised match types.
